description: Look up an ERC-8004 agent on Base by its ID (chainId:agentId, e.g. 8453:45250). Returns the Grade A details if the agent is on AAO's Grade A list, otherwise status "not_listed". Not being on AAO's Grade A list does not mean an agent is untrustworthy. Read-only; data from AAO's published report.
name: lookup_agent
title: Look up an agent in AAO's Grade A list
